C1478.title: Amitabh Bachchan Wins Metaverse Identity Theft Case
C1478.summary: Indian actor Amitabh Bachchan faced unauthorized use of his voice, face, and name in the metaverse. The Delhi High Court ruled to protect his virtual identity rights, making this a landmark case in metaverse identity theft.
